ads-red.why: X keeps the distinct grey-blue column mid-right and the peach band bottom-left; Y is muddier and its columns blur together.

agents-pale.why: Y has the fine diagonal streak texture and the purple-navy tone; X's mass is a smooth blob and too saturated blue.

api-grey.why: X's fine fanned streaks and the dark lower-right band match; Y's smooth S-curve and hard dark corner do not.

architect-square.why: X's straighter diagonal boundary and blue-violet left edge are closer; Y bends into too strong an arc.

architect-wide.why: Y's deeper navy mass beside the maroon matches the reference's saturated blues; otherwise the two are near-identical.

atom-band.why: Y has the pale left streak with a pink fringe and a purple-blue lower-left; X's pale wedge is too blue and low.

belgium-amber.why: Y's blue-grey top across both corners is closer, and it lacks X's stray dark hairline arc in the amber.

cobalt-openai.why: X keeps the fine streak texture across the lighter blue field; Y is too soft.

coral-green.why: X's sharp diagonal streaks with green hairlines match the reference; Y's green is a soft blob.

coral-pink.why: Y's clear blue-grey top-left corner and warm fringe beside it are closer; X's corner turns teal.

defining-navy.why: X keeps the top-right lighter and the maroon confined to the lower-left; Y spreads maroon and darkens the top-right.

detect-navy.why: Y's cyan hairline and the lighter blue streaks down the right edge are closer; the masses are otherwise very similar.

elections-green.why: Y carries streaks into the pale lower area as the reference does; X's bottom is a flat mint.

fedramp-oxblood.why: Y's broad, soft pale wedge is closer than X's hard edge with its rainbow fringe.

green-peach-blur.why: X's rounded top-right peach blob and its mid blob are placed and sized right; Y's top blob is a thin vertical bar.

lavender-cream.why: X's big black corner, olive tints and boundary height match; Y's boundary sits too low and its black corner is too small.

letter-sky.why: Y has the lavender-pink streak across the upper-left and the pink lower-right that the reference shows.

mcp-coral.why: X has the radial burst of many coral rays; Y is a smooth blob with almost no rays.

netherlands-amber.why: Y's dusty beige-and-orange tonality matches; X's saturated peach highlight blobs are too contrasty.

pink-lilac.why: X's mauve streaks top-left, magenta lower-right streak and lilac lower-left all match; Y's bands are too hard and broad.

reader-pastel.why: Y has the many small motion-blurred teal blobs and pink flecks; X's few big round blobs read wrong.

reception-green.why: Y's dark green spot at the left edge and its streak variation in the green are closer; the overall layout is similar.

red-burst.why: Y has the chunky streak segments and the pale left edge; X converges too low and runs too smooth.

rust-blur.why: Y's smaller dark blob, cream bottom-left corner and dark top-right match; X's dark blob is far too large.

scribe-green.why: X's lighter, airy green palette with a pale lower-right is closer; Y is darker and heavier.

sdr-amber.why: X's blue wedge is the right size and sky tone; Y's wedge is too large and grey, though X's burst core is too orange.

sdr-oxblood.why: Y's fuller dark top-left mass is closer to the reference, despite a hairline that is a bit too strong.

sfx-grey.why: Y's top streak rises diagonally as in the reference and its top-right is darker; X's top streak is too flat.

silk-blue.why: X's straight diagonal navy band and pale band match; Y's band curves into an S and takes on a teal tint.

sky-burst.why: X matches the convergence point, the blue spot top-right and the soft streak running to the lower right; Y's right wedge is too dark.

social-cream.why: X has the orange streak on the left and the brownish lower-left; Y's cream area is too broad and plain.

social-ember.why: X's dark green blob top-left and curved red petals at the bottom match; Y smears everything into vertical streaks.

support-teal.why: Y's warm cream on the left and the teal step's position are slightly closer; the two are very similar.

v4-turbo.why: X places the central pale streak and the saturated red bottom closer to the reference.

workshop-red.why: Y's grey top spanning the width and its pinkish upper band match the reference better.
